request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work (law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, company and plant
documents) using ONLY the documents in the current folder, one text file per document; README.md lists them with their rank. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need: search in English and in Italian, follow references from one article or annex to another, and read the whole section before you rely on it.

Rules:
- Use only the files. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- Answer only if a passage states the answer for the exact subject asked about (the same device, the same article
  and paragraph, the same kind of verification, the same deadline). A passage about a neighbouring subject does not
  answer the question: then the kind is "unknown" and the value is null. A question about something that happened
  (the date of the last check, whether something is overdue today) is "unknown" unless a passage records that event.
- A passage marked "corrected by the corrigendum" already shows the corrected wording: reason with it. The old
  wording, given in the mark, is no longer valid.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the passages, one by one. A repeal or an
  application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a date is still fully in
  force on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does not yet bind on earlier days.
- When passages of different rank disagree, the higher rank wins: law, then guidance, then manufacturer's manual,
  then company procedure, then plant record. Between two Italian texts, a legislative decree (D.Lgs.) wins over a
  ministerial decree (DM). Say which one wins.
- A row of a table belongs to the thing named in that same row. Read the row of the item asked about, not a
  neighbouring row. When the question itself states a condition ("if it were in regular use", "built in 2017"),
  reason with that condition.
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / by which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "how often / for how
  long / within what time" is "duration"; "can / may / is / does / must" is "boolean"; "which / what (several
  things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition is "text" (one short sentence naming every element asked for).
- Point at the evidence: for every passage you rely on, copy word for word the sentence, or the table row, that
  states what you use. Copy exactly, without changing a character; do not join text from two places.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not state it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "what the passages say and how it leads to the answer, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y", "P6M", "P45D", "PT1H" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "evidence": [{"file": "<file name>", "quote": "<copied exactly from that file, one sentence or one table row>"}]}
request.prompt:

Question: Which annex of the Regulation does Annex IV of Directive 2006/42/EC correspond to?

What the fact store already holds on this question (facts taken earlier from these same documents, each with the
sentence it comes from). They are leads, not the answer: a fact can be incomplete, about a neighbouring subject,
or wrong. Check each one you use against the files, and search further whenever they do not settle the question.
The store has no answer of its own.
Facts (subject | relation | value | condition | [document, place]):
- Directive 2006/42/EC | repealed from | 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) | [CORR, Corrigendum, point 5] | sentence: "read: ‘ 20 January 2027 ’."
- categories of machinery listed in Annex IV | requires procedure | one of the procedures referred to in Article 12(3) and (4) | [DIR, Annex IV] | sentence: "ANNEX IV Categories of machinery to which one of the procedures referred to in Article 12(3) and (4) must be applied 1."
- machinery referred to in Annex IV | requires procedure | EC type-examination procedure | if: provided that those standards cover all of the relevant essential health and safety requirements | [DIR, Art. 12(3)] | sentence: "(b) the EC type-examination procedure provided for in Annex IX, plus the internal checks on the manufacture of machinery provided for in Annex VIII, point 3;"
- categories of machinery in Annex I Part B | requires procedure | one of the procedures referred to in Article 25(3) | [REG, Annex I, Part B] | sentence: "PART B Categories of machinery or related products to which one of the procedures referred to in Article 25(3) shall be applied:"
- machinery referred to in Annex IV | requires procedure | the EC type-examination procedure provided for in Annex IX | if: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and has not been manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article… | [DIR, Art. 12(4)] | sentence: "(a) the EC type-examination procedure provided for in Annex IX, plus the internal checks on the manufacture of machinery provided for in Annex VIII, point 3;"
- verifiche periodiche delle attrezzature dell'Allegato VII | verified by | personale specializzato dell’ASP di competenza o Organismo privato riconosciuto | if: Per particolari attrezzature, il cui utilizzo comporta pericoli particolari e riportate nell’Allegato VII | [unict-guideline, p. 1] | sentence: "Per particolari attrezzature, il cui utilizzo comporta pericoli particolari e riportate nell’Allegato VII del T.U. e ss.mm.ii., occorre eseguire verifiche periodiche con una periodicità stabilita dal legislatore da parte di personale specializzato dell’ASP di competenza o Organismo privato riconosciuto."
- categories of machinery and related products | listed in | listed in Annex I | [REG, Art. 6(4)] | sentence: "Article 6 Categories of machinery and related products listed in Annex I subject to relevant conformity assessment procedures."
- machinery referred to in Annex IV | requires procedure | full quality assurance | [DIR, Annex X] | sentence: "ANNEX X Full quality assurance This Annex describes the conformity assessment of machinery referred to in Annex IV, manufactured using a full quality assurance system, and the procedure whereby a notified body assesses and approves the quality system and monitors its application."
- machinery and related products in categories listed in Annex I, Part B | requires procedure | specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(3) | [REG, Art. 6(1)] | sentence: "Machinery and related products that fall within the categories listed in Annex I, Part A, shall be subject to the specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(2), and machinery and related products that fall within the categories listed in Annex I, Part B shall be subject to the specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(3)."
- technical documentation | has obligation | shall include at least the following elements | [REG, Annex IV, Part A] | sentence: "The technical documentation shall include at least the following elements:"
- machinery and related products in categories listed in Annex I, Part A | requires procedure | specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(2) | [REG, Art. 6(1)] | sentence: "Machinery and related products that fall within the categories listed in Annex I, Part A, shall be subject to the specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(2), and machinery and related products that fall within the categories listed in Annex I, Part B shall be subject to the specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(3)."
- Datore di Lavoro/RDRL | has obligation | deve mettere a disposizione dei lavoratori le informazioni ed istruzioni d’uso | if: anche per le attrezzature antecedenti all’emanazione della Direttiva Macchine | [univpm-guideline, p. 7] | sentence: "In ogni caso, anche per le attrezzature antecedenti all’emanazione della Direttiva Macchine, in ottemperanza dell’art. 73 del D.lgs. 81/08, il Datore di Lavoro/RDRL deve mettere a disposizione dei lavoratori le informazioni ed istruzioni d’uso che devono risultare comprensibili ai lavoratori interessati."
